name: Hoshizora Tea Party
source: Spring, the cherry blossom season... A warm day continued in Hoshirai academy, when the incident occured. The protagonist was driven out of the apartment where he was going to live, and now he is staying at the school's dinner room. Alice, a girl, which was created from the protagonist's delusions and has an ability to dive into the people's dreams. Kokoro, a mysterious woman with an unknown ability. Teru, an honor student with an ability to materialize photos, which she made. Umi, a girl with an ability to make the people's dreams come true. And Nemu, a girl with ability to bring a stuffed toys to life. And so their days began...
translation: 春天，樱花盛开的季节……事件发生时，星井学园继续着温暖的日子。主角被赶出了自己要住的公寓，现在住在学校的食堂。爱丽丝，一个女孩，从主角的妄想中诞生，拥有潜入人们梦境的能力。可可罗，一个拥有未知能力的神秘女人。Teru，一名优秀学生，具有将她制作的照片实体化的能力。海，一个有能力让人们梦想成真的女孩。还有Nemu，一个有能力让毛绒玩具栩栩如生的女孩。他们的日子就这样开始了……
